picks.headline: Official Unity Plugin for Claude Code
picks.excerpt: Unity shipped an official Claude Code plugin that installs Unity-authored skills, the Unity CLI and live Editor control via Unity's MCP server in a single command. Agentic coding now has a sanctioned path into the Unity Editor itself.
picks.rationale: First-party, install-today path for an agent to drive the Unity Editor — the single most actionable change to a game designer's tooling this week.

picks.headline: Roblox Reality brings greater realism to Roblox graphics
picks.excerpt: At RDC 2026 Roblox exec Anupam Singh demoed Roblox Reality, a video world model that layers photoreal lighting and detail on top of blocky Roblox geometry at runtime. It reframes the art pipeline: creators keep building simple shapes while a generative render pass supplies the finish.
picks.rationale: A runtime world model that finishes creator geometry flips where visual quality lives in the art pipeline — the strongest single RDC 2026 announcement for designers (only one RDC item kept).

picks.headline: How EchoForge Uses Spatial Sound to Build 3D Worlds in Unity
picks.excerpt: Researchers Anamaria Buliga and Kamil Tebani explain how EchoForge combines spatial audio analysis, scene graphs and procedural generation to turn sound recordings into explorable Unity environments. A rare look at non-visual input driving level generation.
picks.rationale: Sound as a generation input is a genuinely new authoring modality for level design, explained with enough method detail to try.

picks.headline: 'You Were a Beautiful Studio' — Level-5 Dev Calls AI Backlash a 'Learning Opportunity' as Fans Worry for Professor Layton's Future
picks.excerpt: Level-5 has apologised for and explained its generative AI use after fans spotted AI artefacts in footage of Professor Layton and the Curious Village, DecaPolice and other reveals. A studio with a signature hand-drawn look getting caught mid-pipeline shift.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool and a concrete cautionary case: a signature art style eroded by AI artefacts that shipped into a reveal.

picks.headline: "What in the vibe-coded s*** is this" - RuneScape players revolt as gen-AI copycat game appears and eventually attracts the eye of Jagex
picks.excerpt: Elderwood, a generative-AI-built website its creator called an Old School RuneScape clone, was pulled after Jagex took notice. A live case study in what vibe-coded game production actually produces — and how fast players and IP owners react.
picks.rationale: Shows the ceiling of vibe-coded game production and the speed of player plus IP-holder response — a useful boundary marker for teams eyeing the same shortcut.
